messages:
alex: Quick check — planning to enable feature flag `prefetch_batching_v2` today for the cache/batching perf rollout. Internal perf shows ~12% token cost drop. Need agreement on canary scope, rollout windows, and rollback triggers. Target start 09:30 PT.

priya: SGTM. Can you propose an exact audience + monitoring checklist? :eyes:

alex: Proposed plan: 
- Stage A: internal accounts + staging services (0 user-facing traffic)
- Stage B: 0.5% traffic in us-west-2 only (single region)
- Stage C: 2% global
- Stage D: 5% global if stable
Each stage: 20–30m steady-state + manual check before next ramp.

martin: Add concrete KPIs/alerts please. I want thresholds we can act on automatically.

alex: KPIs to watch (automated + manual):
- p95 latency (inference path): absolute increase > 50ms or relative > 5% -> pause
- 99th token latency: any increase > 100ms -> pause
- Error rate (5xx): > 0.2% -> rollback
- Client 429s: > 0.5% -> rollback
- GPU mem pressure: sustained > 90% for 2 minutes -> rollback
- Token CPU per request: fail to improve by at least 5% vs baseline -> rollback
Also watch routing fallbacks and KV cache hit ratio.

jia: How do we flip the flag and how do we roll back fast if needed?

alex: Commands below (use ops-cli or the console):
```
# enable canary in us-west-2 for 0.5% traffic
ops-cli feature toggle set prefetch_batching_v2 --on --audience region:us-west-2,percent:0.5 --note "canary start"

# ramp to 2%
ops-cli feature toggle set prefetch_batching_v2 --on --audience percent:2.0 --note "ramp 2%"

# immediate rollback (global off)
ops-cli feature toggle set prefetch_batching_v2 --off --note "rollback - incident"
```

samir: Warm-up plan: before Stage B, run warmup on canary instances to avoid cold misses. Use loadgen: 
```
/tools/loadgen --profile prefetch-warmup --region us-west-2 --duration 10m --concurrency 10
```
This will pre-populate KV cache and prime batching paths.

martin: On alerts: I'll add a temporary rule in the canary alerting policy that pages eng-oncall + posts to #eng-oncall if any KPIs breach. Also add a synthetic check hitting a known prompt set every 2 min.

deploy-bot: Note: Automated canary monitor created (canary-job-196840). It will post anomaly events to #eng-oncall and open an incident if thresholds exceeded.

priya: I'll own the rollout and be watching the dashboards. I'll be in the channel during the whole window. @martin please ack PR #4521 is merge-ready so we can toggle.

martin: reviewing now, small nits fixed, tests green — lgtm, feel free to merge.

alex: Final pre-rollout checklist (do before Stage B):
- [x] PR merged (#4521)
- [x] Canary monitor up (canary-job-196840)
- [x] Warm-up run scheduled (10m)
- [x] Alerting policy adjusted (temporary thresholds)
- [x] Oncall + rollout owner present (priya)
- [ ] Post-rollout doc + perf numbers to /docs/rollouts/prefetch-batching-v2 (create after successful 5% run)

priya: Starting internal stage now, will post short updates every checkpoint. :thumbsup:

alex: Thanks — ping me if any anomalies, otherwise we'll proceed to 0.5% after warm-up.

samir: I'll keep loadgen results streaming to the dashboard and tag suspicious runs.

deploy-bot: Canary monitor status: ok (0 anomalies in last 5m).
